messages:
oliver: Sales flagged a request: some EU tenants want scheduled "cheap-mode" windows (evenings) that route to a quantized variant. They insisted on an explicit canary plan + audit trail before enabling.
sasha: We should treat this like a feature flag rollout with a scheduled predicate: tenant.schedule=true + time-window. Important: customers must opt-in and acknowledge potential small quality delta.
maia: From QA: we need two parallel checks for each tenant during warmup: (1) synthetic prompt-set pass and (2) live A/B probe for signal on real traffic. Suggest 50 synthetic prompts minimum and 1:1 A/B on sampled live requests for the first 48h.
ricardo: Router/infra notes: implement warmup weight steps per tenant. Default ramp: 0.5% -> 2% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with configurable hold times. Each step must hold until gating signals are green.
oncall-bot: canary-run: eu-scheduled-probe queued -> duration:48h -> initiated_by:oliver.
maia: Gating signals: p95 latency delta < +20% OR p95 absolute < 350ms; end-to-end error-rate delta < +0.4%; semantic divergence < 1.2% on tenant prompt set. Any one violation triggers tenant revert.
sasha: Add capacity circuit-breaker: if eu-gpu-util > 80% for 4m OR router-queue-latency > 200ms for 3m -> throttle warmups and divert new opt-in allocations to the premium pool.
ricardo: Implementation detail: expose per-tenant opt-in status + current warmup % and reason codes via the router /admin endpoint for SRE and via Console for tenant admins. Also add immutable audit entries when schedule toggled.
sales-bot: sales: please prepare a one-pager for customers that explains tradeoffs, expected savings, and the acceptance checkbox language. We need to show example savings ranges.
oliver: Rollback ladder (keeps it simple): 1) turn off tenant.schedule in Console, 2) set global flag force_pinned_variant=true, 3) divert scheduled opt-in traffic to premium pool, 4) if systemic -> open incident and pause all scheduled opt-ins.
maia: Small-tenant rule: tenants with <2TPS need 72h observation before full cutover due to sampling noise. Display "awaiting stability" in Console and don't auto-progress ramp.
sasha: UX: Console should support: schedule editor, preview expected opt-in % over time, emergency contact capture, and a required acceptance checkbox with exact wording. Also show historical timeline of toggles and reasons.
ricardo: For A/B probes, we store paired outputs encrypted and only retain for 30 days. Need legal sign-off on retention. Also include a short privacy blurb in the consent flow.
oliver: Owners: Oliver -> product signoff & runbook, Sasha -> Console + consent flow, Maia -> eval harness + synthetic sets, Ricardo -> router + circuit-breaker. I'll coordinate pilot customers.
oncall-bot: alert-rule: eu-gpu-util > 82% for 3m -> auto-divert opt-in traffic.
sales-bot: Outreach: will ask for pilot volunteers (2 tenants) and collect emergency contacts.
oliver: Checklist before customer enablement: feature flags + schedule predicate in staging, Console consent + audit log, synthetic tests + A/B probe passing in staging, 48h live shadow for pilot tenant, dashboard + alerts wired, runbook + rollback ladder documented.
maia: Accept criteria: synthetic pass AND live probe p95 within threshold for two consecutive observation windows (default 1h). If either fails, immediate revert.
sasha: Action items: Sasha build Console mock (due Wed), Ricardo push router hooks + admin endpoints (due Thu), Maia assemble tenant prompt templates (due Thu), Oliver draft runbook + customer one-pager (due Tue).
ricardo: I'll also add a simulation job to estimate cost delta for each pilot tenant using historical traffic slices so Sales can show expected savings.
oliver: If no objections, start staging probe tomorrow morning and invite first pilot tenant next week. :thumbsup:
maia: lgtm.
sasha: no objections.
ricardo: ready.
